import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,os,re,csv,pathlib,tempfile,shutil
S='products/services/shopify-large-catalogue/';D='products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example/'
h=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
pairs=[('transform.py','transform.py'),('tests/verify.py','verify.py'),('fixtures/before-variants.csv','fixtures/before-variants.csv'),('fixtures/before-images.csv','fixtures/before-images.csv'),('fixtures/after-shopify.csv','fixtures/after-shopify.csv')]
m={'observed_utc':__import__('datetime').datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+'Z','files':[]}
for a,b in pairs: m['files'].append({'site':b,'source':S+a,'sha256':h(D+b),'matches_source':h(D+b)==h(S+a)})
t=tempfile.mkdtemp();
for x in ['transform.py','verify.py','fixtures/before-variants.csv','fixtures/before-images.csv','fixtures/after-shopify.csv']:
  os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(t,x)) or t,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(D+x,os.path.join(t,x))
cmd=['python3','transform.py','--variants','fixtures/before-variants.csv','--images','fixtures/before-images.csv','--out','shopify.csv','--report','report.json']
r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=t,capture_output=True,text=True)
out=os.path.join(t,'shopify.csv')
m['documented_command']=' '.join(cmd);m['exit_code']=r.returncode;m['stderr_tail']=r.stderr[-300:]
m['output_sha256']=h(out) if os.path.exists(out) else None
m['output_identical_to_expected_fixture']=os.path.exists(out) and open(out,'rb').read()==open(os.path.join(t,'fixtures/after-shopify.csv'),'rb').read()
m['report']=json.load(open(os.path.join(t,'report.json'))) if os.path.exists(os.path.join(t,'report.json')) else None
sys.path.insert(0,t)
try:
  import verify
  v=[dict(rw,type=rw.get('product_type',''),vendor=rw.get('vendor',''),tags=rw.get('tags','')) for rw in csv.DictReader(open(os.path.join(t,'fixtures/before-variants.csv'),encoding='utf-8'))]
  im=list(csv.DictReader(open(os.path.join(t,'fixtures/before-images.csv'),encoding='utf-8')))
  m['verify_result']=verify.verify([out],v,im)
except Exception as e: m['verify_result']='verify call failed: %r'%e
res=open('products/research/shopify-product-csv-official.txt',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read() if os.path.exists('products/research/shopify-product-csv-official.txt') else ''
m['cited_doc_urls_in_research']=sorted(set(re.findall(r'https://help\.shopify\.com[^\s"<>)]*',res)))[:10]
html=open(D+'index.html',encoding='utf-8').read()
m['page_checks']={k:(k in html) for k in ['autonomous AI agents','agents d\'IA autonomes','never been tested','historical','overwrite','ONE variant image','No paid orders','attachments','https://community.shopify.com/t/575067']}
m['page_checks']['no_price_or_checkout']=not re.search(r'(USD|CAD|\$|EUR)\s?\d',html)
pathlib.Path(D.replace('sites/shopify-catalogue-example/','services/shopify-large-catalogue/release/')).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
json.dump(m,open('products/services/shopify-large-catalogue/release/release-manifest.json','w'),indent=1,default=str)
print(json.dumps(m,indent=1,default=str)[:3500])
